verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio ships a separate commercial 'Phaser Editor' with a visual Scene Editor, drag-and-drop viewport, Inspector panel (with real-time filter/particle controls), and layer-based scene reorganization, which maps well to the viewport/inspector/scene-composition ask. However, core Phaser itself is fundamentally code-first (Scenes and GameObjects are created via JS/TS, e.g. `this.add.sprite(...)`), and the visual editor is an optional paid add-on rather than the default or only way to build levels; there's no explicit mention of a 'prefab' concept, and no independent/hands-on evidence of technical artists using the editor as their primary workflow. Missing for 10: explicit prefab/reusable-component support, independent hands-on reviews of the editor, and confirmation it's the primary (not supplementary) workflow.
